$comment: Part 4, gate-ON condition. The two new freeloaders, on top of the Parts 1-3 baseline: the edit-time template-modernity vocabulary hook (@if over *ngIf, no ngClass/ngStyle), and strictTemplates (turned on by the driver before the agent builds, so the compiler's template type-checker fails the build on a binding that does not typecheck). Sealing, layout, and component shape stay on in both conditions.
